title: The Difficult Test
content:
Liam had a test at school yesterday. He studied, but he was still nervous.

After the test, his teacher called him.

—Did you understand the questions?

—Yes, I did. But I didn't know one answer.

—Did you study for the test?

—Yes, I did. I studied last night.

—Did you sleep well?

—No, I didn't. I was very nervous.

The next day, the teacher gave Liam his test.

—Did you pass?

Liam looked at his grade and smiled.

—Yes, I did!

—Great! You didn't give up, and your hard work helped you.

Liam smiled.

—The test was difficult, but I learned a lot.
